latestVersion.changelog:
VN Video Editor — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered video editing: upload raw clips, describe your edits, and export polished 1080p videos in minutes.
- Fully automatic setup: instantly connects via anonymous token with no manual config needed.
- Supports uploading, editing, timeline preview, credits checking, status display, and easy export—no timeline dragging or export setting menus.
- Provides clear feedback for workflow steps and error cases like unsupported files, token expiry, or plan limits.
- Wide format support (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac); handles clips up to 500MB.
- Efficient session and state management keeps your project progress and enables iterative editing without re-uploading.
